definitions.full: H7075. qinyan קִנְיָן noun [masculine] thing got or aquired, acquisition (Aramaism, Lag BN:205); absolute ׳ק Ezek 38:12-13 , construct קִנְיַן Lev 22:11 ; suffix קִנְיָָֽנְךָ Prov 4:7 +, etc.; — 1 thing acquired by purchase כֶּסֶף קִנְיַן Lev 22:11 (H; compare מִקְנָה ); of property Gen 34:23 ; 36:6 ; Josh 14:4 (all P), Ezek 38:12-13 , (in all distinguished from מִקְנֶה cattle); || בַּיִת Psa 105:21 ; קִנְיָנוֺ מִקְנֵח Gen 31:18 (P; probably doublet, ᵐ5 omitted); בִינָה קְנֵה בְּכָלקִֿנְיָֽנְךָ Prov 4:7 with (or at the price of) all that thou hast acquired, get understanding . 2 more Generally: collective creatures ᵐ5 κτίσις Psa 104:24 (compare √ 1a ).
